pineview.scope: Local reporting and current pipeline project access notices.

lake-powell.scope: Recent local reporting, NPS launch status and dated flood advisories.

deer-creek.scope: Park access/service notices and local reporting.

items.title: Pineview Reservoir is almost empty. Draining it turned up some surprises
items.summary: Pineview was lowered for pipeline replacement. The ongoing construction drawdown affects boating access; confirm launch availability before towing.
items.ongoingEvidence: The project website lists the Pineview crossing as active and schedules reservoir-bed work through February 1, 2027.
items.impactEvidence: KUER describes pipeline work on the exposed reservoir bed; the current project notice describes inaccessible boat ramps.

items.title: Changing Lake Levels
items.summary: NPS lists multiple launch closures, including Halls Crossing and Hite. Stateline Auxiliary and Bullfrog Primitive remain motorized options; Bullfrog North carries launch-at-your-own-risk guidance.
items.ongoingEvidence: Current NPS ramp table was reviewed on October 23, 2026.
items.impactEvidence: NPS gives vessel-specific launch availability and warns that changing shorelines affect ramp usability.
items.severityEvidence: NPS marks named ramps closed; this is not a lake-wide closure.

items.title: Deer Creek State Park
items.summary: The park says its AIS decontamination station closes for the season October 25, 2026. Plan decontamination arrangements separately from ramp access.
items.ongoingEvidence: The park currently lists the October 25 seasonal decontamination-station closure.
items.impactEvidence: A seasonal station closure affects post-trip decontamination planning. It is not a lake or ramp closure.
